question: Which former athlete was honoured with the Lifetime Achievement Award at BBC Indian Sportswoman of the Year 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anju Bobby George.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kerala-based long jumper and Olympian Anju Bobby George **has bagged the **BBC lifetime achievement award for best athlete in India.**
 
• Anju bagged a** bronze medal by clearing 6.70 m **in the** long jump at the World Athletic Championship 2003 in Paris.**
 
• She was the** first Indian athlete ever to win a medal in the world athletics championship**.
 
• She won the Woman of the year Award from world Athletics for grooming young girls to take up sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• ** Anita Sood**

 
 
• She is a former **National Women swimming champion** of India.
 
• She became the **fastest Asian swimmer to cross the English Channel.**
 
 
 
• **Diana Edulji**
 
 
• She is a former **Indian Test cricketer.**
 
• She holds the record for **delivering the most balls by any woman cricketer** in Women's test history.
 
 
 
• **PT Usha**
 
 
• Her full name is **Pilavullakandi Thekkeparambil Usha.**
 
• She is a retired** Indian track and field athlete.**
 
• She is best known for her** incredible run at the 1984 Los Angeles Olympic Games.**
